$$G_{d,d'}:\mathcal{D}(d,d')\longrightarrow\mathcal{E}(Gd,Gd')$$
is an isomorphism in $\mathcal{V}$.

By the definition of composition of $\mathcal{V}$-functors, the action of $G\circ F$ on hom-objects factors as:
$$\mathcal{C}(c,c')\xrightarrow{\;F_{c,c'}\;}\mathcal{D}(Fc,Fc')\xrightarrow{\;G_{Fc,Fc'}\;}\mathcal{E}(GFc,GFc'),$$
that is,
$$(G\circ F)_{c,c'}=G_{Fc,Fc'}\circ F_{c,c'}.$$
